name: Search Issues with JQL
description: Search for issues using JQL (Jira Query Language). [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/api-group-issue-search/#api-rest-api-3-search-jql-get)

configurable_props.name: jql
configurable_props.label: JQL Query
configurable_props.description: The JQL query to search for issues. [See the documentation for syntax and examples](https://support.atlassian.com/jira-software-cloud/docs/what-is-advanced-search-in-jira-cloud/)

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default: 50)

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Fields
configurable_props.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each issue

configurable_props.name: expand
configurable_props.label: Expand
configurable_props.description: Use expand to include additional information about the issues in the response

options.label: Returns field values rendered in HTML format
Returns the display name of each field
Returns the schema describing a field type
Returns all possible transitions for the issue
Returns information about how each field can be edited
Returns a list of recent updates to an issue, sorted by date, starting from the most recent
Returns a JSON array for each version of a field's value, with the highest number representing the most recent version

configurable_props.name: properties
configurable_props.label: Properties
configurable_props.description: A list of up to 5 issue properties to include in the results. This parameter accepts a comma-separated list.

configurable_props.name: fieldsByKeys
configurable_props.label: Fields by Keys
configurable_props.description: Reference fields by their key (rather than ID). The default is `false`.

configurable_props.name: failFast
configurable_props.label: Fail Fast
configurable_props.description: Fail this request early if we can't retrieve all field data
